name: play-together
description: Workspace orchestrator for the Play Together capstone: Expo app, NestJS API and admin console.

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix play-together-be && npm ci --prefix play-together-admin && npm ci --prefix play-together-fe
scripts.build: npm --prefix play-together-be run build && npm --prefix play-together-admin run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix play-together-be run typecheck && npm --prefix play-together-fe run typecheck && npm --prefix play-together-admin run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix play-together-be run lint && npm --prefix play-together-fe run lint && npm --prefix play-together-admin run lint
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
